title: Search Invocation Contract — Single WebSearch Tool Pipeline
description: Defines the hard rules for what constitutes a valid live_search invocation in Codex Factory. Any search result that does not meet these rules MUST be classified as D (invalid) or C (failed).
pipeline: need_search → Provider Selector → WebSearch Tool/API/MCP → Quality Gate → Research Intake → Evidence Pack → Agents

selectedSearchPath.description: Server-side web_search invocation via ZhipuAI GLM-4. Model receives search results in context and returns URLs in response content.
forbidden: LLM knowledge answer as search result

classificationRules.A: LIVE_SEARCH_TOOL_OR_API_INVOKED_AND_EP_VERIFIED: all fatal gates pass, external sources present
classificationRules.B: LIVE_PROVIDER_API_CONNECTED_BUT_SEARCH_NOT_INVOKED: provider API call succeeded but web_search tool was not triggered
classificationRules.C: LIVE_SEARCH_ATTEMPT_FAILED_WITH_EVIDENCE: invocation attempted but quality gate rejected
classificationRules.D: INVALID / MOCKED / DRY_RUN / KNOWLEDGE_ANSWER_MISLABELED: plain chat, mock, or regression

phaseHistory.R2.3-Q: Provider API connected, search NOT verified (corrected from A to A_PROVIDER)
phaseHistory.R2.3-R: Search tool/API invoked and EP verified (Classification A)
phaseHistory.R2.3-S: Pipeline consolidated with regression guardrails (this contract)
